goal: Dump the communicator (conversations, full message histories, attachments) and the drive documents tree with incremental re-runs, extending the existing sync pipeline.
preserved_behavior: inso-dumper login and children, and the announcements/galleries sync path (timeline client, posts manifest table, dir_name rule) are unchanged.
CLI exit codes (2/3/4/5/6/99) and the closed CliErrorKind union are unchanged; no new exit code is added.

Read-only guarantee: only GET requests are ever issued; POST /system-api/conversations/read-all-unread (mark-as-read), POST /system-api/messages/attachment (upload), and all /drive/directory* and /drive/file* write endpoints are never called (test-pinned).
Disk invariants: dump/ 0700 dirs, 0600 files, gitignored output; signed URLs never relied on (bytes in _common/ are the durable artifact).

Manifest schema gate: a manifest with PRAGMA user_version not in {0, 3} is rejected with Err(CONFIG, 'manifest_schema') — loud, no silent migration; the v2 posts table and its accessors are unchanged.
AGENTS.md rules (uv-only, functional core / imperative shell, Result-typed boundaries that never raise, match/assert_never for closed unions) are honored end-to-end.
